Abhishek Kumar Singh And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3
Others on 19 September, 2023

Author: Vivek Kumar Birla
Bench: Vivek Kumar Birla
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:181356-Db
Court No. - 45
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 13894 of 2023
Petitioner :- Abhishek Kumar Singh And 2 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Narendra Singh,Saroj Kumar Dubey Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1. Heard Sri Saroj Kumar Dubey, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri Rajesh Kumar Mateshiya, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents.

2. The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the F.I.R. dated 02.08.2023 registered as Case Crime No. 0428 of 2023 under Sections 420, 409 IPC, Police Station- Kotwali, District- Azamgarh.
Further prayer has been made not to arrest the petitioner in the aforesaid case.

sentences.text:
Submissions of learned counsel for the petitioners are that no date, time or place has been mentioned in the first information report; the petitioners are only employee of the informant company and are doing job of loading the cash in various Banks' ATM; and certain amount has also been deposited/refunded by the petitioners in the Bank and they have not committed any offence,
submission is that this criminal prosecution has been lodged after the three months of the termination of services of the petitioners and has no legs to stand.
4. Per contra, learned A.G.A. submits that a bare reading of the first information report discloses cognizable offence.
5. Perusal of the impugned first information report prima facie reveals commission of cognizable offence.

Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
